summary: Selected repaired Fable proposal 3, the sole cross-review survivor. The verifier freezes an explicit E6 Cartan basis, constructs the 27-vertex minuscule Gosset Delaunay cell, and certifies that these are exactly all lattice points at squared distance at most 4/3 from center (2,1,0,-1,-2,0)/3. It then classifies all integral 3x6 port maps with entries in {-1,0,1}. A complete 729-row search proves that only the zero row takes values contained in {0,1} or {0,-1} on all shell vertices. Since every legal NAND port bit varies, no three-row map can hit all four legal words. The rowwise reduction covers all 3^18=387420489 maps. This is finite rejection of the prescribed E6 map family, not a theorem about larger maps or other Delaunay cells.
hypothesis: Causal mechanism: an irreducible already-empty E6 Gosset shell might avoid D4 recombination attacks and admit an integral projection whose complete 27-vertex image consists exactly of the four legal NAND words. Expected move: certify the empty shell and find a surjective legal port map before COPY or transfer testing. Falsification condition: any malformed shell image or failure to realize all four legal words. Exact row classification proves the latter for every bounded map.

tests.finding: Certified the exact 27-point empty E6 shell by enumerating the derived [-3,3]^6 bound, then covered all 387420489 bounded 3x6 maps through exhaustive enumeration of 729 rows and found no NAND port-map survivor.
Two complete verifier runs produced byte-identical JSON.

next_experiment: Keep the certified E6 shell but freeze a bounded nonlinear or redundant orbit-valued port codebook rather than a single integral 3x6 projection. Require every one of the 27 vertices to receive a legal NAND state, all four states to occur, and gluing determinism to be emitted before attempting COPY or transfer growth.
